title: Clean Asset Image Tool

SynthID removal is not verified and AI-label avoidance is not guaranteed. Requires a retry idempotency key and storage quota.

title: Asset Upload Policies Tool

title: Cancel Asset Upload Tool
description: Cancel an upload session and release its reservation through the upload lifecycle. Read status to confirm cancellation; do not reuse cancelled part URLs.

title: Complete Asset Upload Tool
description: Complete the byte transfer with its upload lease. Processing/verification may continue asynchronously; poll get-asset-upload until ready and use its result asset ID/URL. Completion requested does not mean the file is ready.

title: Get Asset Upload Tool
description: Poll upload session state and retrieve its managed media result, error_code and retryability. A session ID is not a media ID.

title: Lease Asset Upload Tool
description: Acquire or renew the upload lease with a client-generated UUID token. Pass the same token as upload_lease for part URLs and completion.

title: Prepare Asset Upload Tool
description: Create a resumable upload session. Client sends bytes using signed URLs after acquiring a lease, then completes and polls status. Reuse idempotency_key on retries.

title: Upload Asset Tool
description: Upload image/video bytes encoded as base64, up to 6 MiB decoded. Useful when a client can read its attachment. Prefer resumable multipart for larger files; approval queues limit argument size to 64 KiB. Do not send a local file path. Reuse idempotency_key on retry.

title: Get Automation Catalog Tool
description: List permitted automation actions and event schemas.

title: List Automation Templates Tool
description: List built-in workflow templates.

title: Get Automation Template Tool
description: Get one workflow template definition.

title: Get Automation Options Tool
description: Search workspace resources for workflow configuration.

title: List Automation Workflows Tool
description: List workspace workflows.

title: Get Automation Workflow Tool
description: Get a workflow draft and status.

title: Save Automation Workflow Tool
description: Save a workflow draft using its revision.

title: Check Automation Workflow Tool
description: Persist workflow validation and audience preview.

title: Simulate Automation Workflow Tool
description: Simulate workflow steps without side effects.

title: Publish Automation Workflow Tool
description: Publish a checked workflow revision.

title: Pause Automation Workflow Tool
description: Pause a published workflow.

title: Resume Automation Workflow Tool
description: Resume a published workflow.

title: Preview Automation Audience Tool
description: Preview eligible recipients without contacting providers.

title: Review Automation Phones Tool
description: Resolve Zalo phone recipients without sending messages.

title: List Automation Runs Tool
description: List workflow runs.

title: Get Automation Run Tool
description: Get run steps and outcomes.

title: Cancel Automation Run Tool
description: Cancel remaining workflow steps.

title: Retry Automation Run Tool
description: Retry a failed or denied action when allowed.

title: List Automation Tasks Tool
description: List automation tasks.

title: Update Automation Task Tool
description: Update an automation task status.

title: Get Mcp Action Tool
description: Read the approval and execution status, result or failure of an MCP action in the current workspace. Poll this after an action returns an action_id; do not resubmit the write.
